'''Requiem Six''' was the position that [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Inyri Forge]] took in the undercover [[Requiem Squadron]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. She posed as Inyon Fass, who was the sister of [[Major/Legends|Major]] Teekon Fass, a role played by [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]].
